name: ember
description: How warm this chat's prompt cache is: one quiet row above the prompt with a ring of minutes until it goes cold and the cost of a cold restart, keep-warm pings on a press (on their own only for chats over 300k tokens), /board with every local chat, and /ember:handoff to continue in a fresh chat.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives idle: auto measures it (an hour on a subscription until a request shows five minutes), or set 5 or 60 minutes.

autoKeepTokens.title: Keep warm by itself from (tokens)
autoKeepTokens.description: A chat with at least this many tokens in context is kept warm by itself in its last minutes. 0 keeps none by itself.

keepWarmHours.title: Keep warm for (hours)
keepWarmHours.description: How long keeping warm lasts once on, before it stops by itself.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language of ember's own words: the band, the board, toasts and command answers.
